title: Stanford team finds two cavities under Khafre pyramid

tellings.quote: standing in. And then in the 70s, another team from Stanford came in and did another scan and they confirmed this.

plain: In the 1970s, a team from Stanford University is said to have scanned the pyramid of Khafre at Giza and confirmed an earlier finding of two hidden cavities beneath it. A researcher named Luke Caverns says this on the show, without naming a source. If true, unexplored spaces lie under one of the great pyramids.
